faq.whatIsEsim: What is an eSIM and how does it work?
faq.whatIsEsimAnswer: An eSIM (embedded SIM) is a digital SIM built into your device. Instead of inserting a physical card, you download and activate a cellular plan directly onto your device. This lets you switch carriers instantly without swapping SIMs.
faq.installIos: How do I install an eSIM on my iPhone?
faq.installIosAnswer: Installing an eSIM on iOS is quick and easy. Make sure your device is eSIM compatible and carrier-unlocked with a stable WiFi connection.
faq.iosStep2: Tap Add eSIM or Add Cellular Plan
faq.iosStep3: Tap Use QR Code and scan the QR code from your email
faq.iosStep4: Choose a label for your eSIM (e.g., "Travel Data")
faq.iosStep5: Select your eSIM for Cellular Data
faq.iosStep7: Enable Data Roaming for your eSIM and you're ready!
faq.installAndroid: How do I install an eSIM on Android/Samsung?
faq.installAndroidAnswer: Android installation varies by manufacturer. Here's how to install on Samsung Galaxy devices:
faq.androidStep3: Scan the QR code from your email or app
faq.androidStep4: Wait for the eSIM to download and activate
faq.androidStep5: Go to SIM Manager → Mobile data → Select your eSIM
faq.androidStep6: Enable Data Roaming if required (check your plan details)
faq.deviceSupportAnswer: Most modern smartphones support eSIM: iPhone XS/XR and newer, Google Pixel 3 and newer, Samsung Galaxy S20 and newer, and many others. Your device must also be carrier-unlocked. Check your device settings or contact us to confirm compatibility.
faq.avoidRoaming: How can I avoid roaming charges when using eSIM?
faq.avoidRoamingAnswer: To avoid unexpected charges from your primary carrier while traveling, follow these important steps:
faq.roamingStep1: Enable Airplane Mode before leaving your home coverage area
faq.roamingStep2: Disable your primary SIM (Settings → Cellular → Primary SIM → Turn Off This Line)
faq.roamingStep3: Turn off Data Roaming for your primary SIM
faq.roamingStep4: Set your eSIM as the default data line
faq.roamingStep5: Turn OFF "Allow Cellular Data Switching" to prevent auto-switching
faq.roamingStep6: Use WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal for calls/messages over data
faq.notConnecting: My eSIM isn't connecting. What should I do?
faq.notConnectingAnswer: If your eSIM isn't connecting to the network, try these troubleshooting steps:
faq.troubleStep1: Ensure you're in an area with network coverage
faq.troubleStep2: Toggle Airplane Mode on, wait 30 seconds, then off
faq.troubleStep4: Check that Data Roaming is enabled for your eSIM
faq.troubleStep5: Try manually selecting a network in Cellular settings
faq.troubleStep6: Verify APN settings if required (check your eSIM instructions)
faq.slowSpeed: Why is my data speed slower than expected?
faq.slowSpeedAnswer: Data speeds vary based on network congestion, your location, device capabilities, and plan type. Some plans may have speed limitations after certain usage. Try moving to a different location or connecting to a different network operator if available.
faq.callsSms: Can I use my eSIM for calls and SMS?
faq.callsSmsAnswer: Our eSIM plans are primarily data-only. For calls and messaging, use VoIP apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, FaceTime, or Skype over your data connection. These work great and often provide better call quality than traditional cellular.
faq.paymentMethods: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.paymentMethodsAnswer: We accept all major credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express), Apple Pay, Google Pay, and various local payment methods. All payments are processed securely through Stripe.
faq.refundPolicy: Can I get a refund if I'm not satisfied?
faq.refundPolicyAnswer: Yes! We offer a 7-day money-back guarantee for unused data plans. If you haven't activated your eSIM or used any data, you can request a full refund within 7 days of purchase. Contact our support team to process your refund.
faq.topUp: Can I add more data to my plan?
faq.topUpAnswer: Yes, you can purchase top-up data for most plans. Go to your Dashboard, find your active eSIM, and look for the "Top Up" option. Top-ups are added to your existing eSIM — no need to install a new one.
faq.unlimitedData: Do your plans include unlimited data?
faq.unlimitedDataAnswer: We offer both limited and unlimited data plans. Unlimited plans may have fair usage policies (typically 1-2GB/day at full speed), after which speeds may be reduced. All limitations are clearly stated in the plan details before purchase.
faq.checkUsage: How do I check my data usage?
faq.checkUsageAnswer: Monitor your data usage in your Dashboard under 'My eSIMs'. You can also check usage directly on your device: iPhone: Settings → Cellular → select your eSIM. Android: Settings → Connections → Data usage.
faq.deleteEsim: How do I delete an eSIM from my device?
faq.deleteStep1: iPhone: Go to Settings → Cellular → Select your eSIM → Delete eSIM
faq.deleteStep2: Android: Go to Settings → Connections → SIM Manager → Select eSIM → Remove
faq.deleteStep3: Note: Deleting an eSIM is permanent. You cannot reinstall the same eSIM once deleted.
faq.multipleEsim: Can I have multiple eSIMs on my device?
faq.multipleEsimAnswer: Yes! Most devices support storing multiple eSIMs (typically 5-8 or more). However, you can usually only have one eSIM active at a time alongside your physical SIM. Switch between eSIMs in your Cellular/SIM settings.
faq.shareEsim: Can I transfer my eSIM to another device?
faq.shareEsimAnswer: eSIMs are tied to the device they're installed on and cannot be transferred. If you need to use your data on a different device, you'll need to purchase a new eSIM for that device.

faq.deviceSupportAnswer: Most modern smartphones support eSIM, including iPhone XS and newer, Google Pixel 3 and newer, Samsung Galaxy S20 and newer, and many others. Check your device settings or contact us to confirm compatibility.
faq.howToActivate: How do I activate my eSIM?
faq.howToActivateAnswer: After purchase, you'll receive a QR code via email. Simply scan this code with your device's camera in the cellular settings, and your eSIM will be activated automatically. Detailed instructions are provided for each device type.

faq.refundPolicy: Can I get a refund if I'm not satisfied?

faq.notConnecting: My eSIM isn't connecting to the network. What should I do?
faq.notConnectingAnswer: First, ensure you're in an area with network coverage. Try restarting your device, toggling airplane mode on/off, or manually selecting the network in your cellular settings. If issues persist, contact our support team.
faq.callsSms: Can I use my eSIM for calls and SMS?

installGuide.pageSubtitle: Step-by-step instructions to install and activate your eSIM

intro.title: What is an eSIM?
intro.p1: An eSIM (embedded SIM) is a digital SIM card built into your device. It allows you to activate a mobile data plan without inserting a physical SIM card.
intro.p2: After purchasing a plan, you will receive a QR code. Scan it with your device to install the eSIM profile and get connected.
intro.p3: Your device must support eSIM technology. Most modern smartphones released after 2018 are compatible.

beforeYouStart.title: Before You Start
beforeYouStart.wifi: Ensure you have a stable internet connection (WiFi recommended).
beforeYouStart.unlocked: Your device must be carrier-unlocked to use an eSIM.
beforeYouStart.vpn: Disable any active VPN before installing.
beforeYouStart.qrReady: Have your QR code visible on another screen or printed out.

iphone.title: iPhone Installation
iphone.step1: Open the Settings app on your iPhone.
iphone.step3: Tap Add eSIM (or Add Cellular Plan).
iphone.step4: Select Use QR Code and scan the QR code you received.
iphone.step5: Tap Continue to confirm the plan installation.
iphone.step6: Choose a label for the new line (e.g. "Travel Data").
iphone.step7: When prompted, set your eSIM as the default data line.
iphone.step8: Go to Settings → Mobile Data → your eSIM and enable Data Roaming.

android.title: Android Installation
android.step1: Open the Settings app on your Android device.
android.step2: Tap Network & Internet (or Connections on Samsung).
android.step5: Scan the QR code you received.
android.step6: Wait for the eSIM profile to download, then tap Confirm to activate.
android.step7: Set the eSIM as your preferred line for mobile data.
android.step8: Enable Data Roaming if your plan requires it.

manual.title: Manual Installation (LPA)
manual.description: If you cannot scan the QR code, you can enter the activation details manually.
manual.howTo: In your device eSIM settings, choose "Enter Details Manually" instead of scanning a QR code, then paste the values above into the corresponding fields.

activation.title: Activation Notes
activation.p1: Your eSIM activates when your device connects to a supported network in the destination country.
activation.p2: It may take a few minutes after the first data session for the connection to fully establish.
activation.tip1: Toggle Airplane Mode on and off.
activation.tip3: Make sure Data Roaming is enabled for the eSIM line.
activation.notActivating: If the eSIM does not activate:

noInternet.a: Make sure the eSIM is set as your default data line and that Data Roaming is enabled. Try toggling Airplane Mode or restarting your device.

qrNotScanning.a: Ensure the QR code is displayed clearly and your camera can focus on it. Try adjusting brightness or distance. You can also use the manual installation method.

alreadyInUse.a: Each QR code can only be used once. If you have already installed the eSIM, check your device SIM settings. If you need a replacement, contact our support team.

noSignal.a: Make sure you are in an area with network coverage. Try manually selecting a network operator in your device settings. Toggle Airplane Mode and restart your device.
